#include <cstdio>

typedef long long ll;

const ll MOD = 1000000007LL;

ll mod_pow(ll a, ll b) {
    ll res = 1;
    while (b) {
        if (b & 1) res = res * a % MOD;
        a = a * a % MOD;
        b >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    ll p, k;
    scanf("%lld%lld", &p, &k);

    if (k == 0) {
        printf("%lld\n", mod_pow(p, p - 1));
        return 0;
    }
    if (k == 1) {
        printf("%lld\n", mod_pow(p, p));
        return 0;
    }

    ll sz = 1;
    ll pos = k % p;
    while (pos != 1) {
        pos = pos * k % p;
        ++sz;
    }

    ll cnt = (p - 1) / sz;
    printf("%lld\n", mod_pow(p, cnt));
    return 0;
}
